Capital Chronicle's midterm review: right scenario, wrong market call

https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/capital-chronicles-midterm-review

Capital Chronicle's review: the election scenario matched, but equities and Bitcoin rose against the downside map.

A right result is not a market-direction model.
Watch: For a future scenario, Capital Chronicle's lesson is to write down the political condition, the proposed market direction and the horizon separately, then ask what would challenge each.

This review shows why the right political answer cannot stand in for that market analysis.




This is a retrospective of Capital Chronicle's dated dossier and review, not a performance record.




Analysis, not financial advice.




Readers decide whether to trade.
Capital Chronicle may hold positions in the markets it covers.
